intro: Hippogryph Harassment is a local task concerning an aggressive flock of wild hippogryphs nesting southeast of Shen'dar Village. Travelers passing along the nearby road have come under frequent attack from the territorial beasts inhabiting the Shen'dar Highlands. To secure the passage, adventurers are called upon to cull the flock's youths, protectors, and their commanding matriarch.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A flock of Hippogryph have recently established nesting grounds southeast of Shen'dar Village and they've been wreaking havoc on travelers on the road. I need someone to head down there and thin them out for us.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, and quickly too. Not too bad at all.
